Current_Mechanism_in_RFDETR: 3-layer shared MLP predicting [cx, cy, w, h] + layer-wise offset addition
Proposed_Mechanism: Discrete distribution modeling over 16 bins per edge + non-uniform weighting refinement W(n) + GO-LSD distillation
Technical_Difference: Replaces continuous scalar regression with discrete probability distribution; replaces direct offset addition with residual distribution adjustment
Pretrained_Weights_Impact: Partial (BBox MLP must be re-initialized, Backbone and Decoder weights preserved)
Inference_Latency_Impact: Zero overhead (Argmax/Expectation takes <0.1ms; GO-LSD discarded during inference)
Status_Tag: [ĐÃ CHỨNG MINH trên RT-DETR/DINO, GIẢ THUYẾT CẦN KIỂM CHỨNG trên RF-DETR]

Current_Mechanism_in_RFDETR: L1 Loss + GIoU Loss (1 - IoU + distance penalty)
Proposed_Mechanism: 2D Gaussian distribution modeling + Normalized Wasserstein Distance (1 - exp(-sqrt(W2)/C))
Technical_Difference: Continuous distance metric independent of overlap; eliminates gradient vanishing/discontinuity when IoU=0 on small objects
Pretrained_Weights_Impact: 100% Preserved (Only modifies training loss and optional Hungarian cost)
Inference_Latency_Impact: Zero overhead (Loss module used only during training)
Status_Tag: [ĐÃ CHỨNG MINH trên AI-TOD, GIẢ THUYẾT CẦN KIỂM CHỨNG trên RF-DETR Food Dataset]

Current_Mechanism_in_RFDETR: Standard GIoU / EIoU with static loss curves
Proposed_Mechanism: Dynamic non-monotonic focusing based on outlier degree beta = L_IoU / L_bar_IoU
Technical_Difference: Dynamically allocates gradient gain r(beta) to reduce penalty on severe label noise/occlusions and easy samples
Status_Tag: [ĐÃ CHỨNG MINH trên YOLO, GIẢ THUYẾT CẦN KIỂM CHỨNG trên Hungarian Matching]

Current_Mechanism_in_RFDETR: Lower learning rate (0.1x base LR) for full backbone fine-tuning

Technical_Difference: Drastically cuts trainable parameters from 22M to 0.3M; prevents catastrophic forgetting of pre-trained visual representations
Pretrained_Weights_Impact: 100% Preserved (Base weights frozen, adapters merged into W at deployment)

Integration_Feasibility: Class B (Feasible with training pipeline adaptation)
